description: Dept. of Elections - Vacated the office of member of the Homagama P/S by Mr. W.M.Ajith Premakumara
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns a member of a local authority (Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha) vacating their office due to ceasing membership in a political party (People's Liberation Front). This is a declaration made under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically relating to the electoral process and the status of an elected official, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
